about: Hebcal's holidays, Rosh Chodesh and weekly readings for the Hebrew years 5760-5820, in Israel (i=on) and abroad (i=off), for driver/tests/test_holidays.lua and test_parasha.lua. Each event is [civil date, title] in Hebcal's ASCII spelling (its title_orig), with a third item true on a Yom Tov. Events that are the same in Israel and abroad are under both, the others under israel or abroad. All 14 year types occur.
